text: The POS terminal at Store #3 keeps freezing during transactions. We've restarted it twice already and it works for about 10 minutes before locking up again.
I can't connect to the VPN from home. The AnyConnect client shows 'Connection failed' after about 30 seconds of trying.
Our entire warehouse lost internet connectivity this morning. All WiFi access points are offline in the management console.
New hire Sarah Chen starts on Monday. Please create her accounts and grant access to the inventory management system and corporate email.
The antivirus flagged suspicious files on the marketing shared drive. Multiple files appear to be ransomware. We need immediate investigation.
The printer on the second floor keeps jamming every few pages. We've already cleared the jam three times today. It might need a service.
Outlook keeps crashing every time I try to open an email with an attachment larger than 5MB. Other team members are experiencing the same issue.
Windows update KB5034441 keeps failing to install on my laptop. Error code 0x800f0922. I've tried running the troubleshooter.
My laptop screen is flickering intermittently. It happens more often when I adjust the screen angle. The laptop is about 18 months old.
We need to update firewall rules to allow the new warehouse management application to communicate with the central database server.
Please remove John Martinez's access to all systems. His last day was yesterday. He should no longer have VPN, email, or inventory system access.
I received a phishing email claiming to be from our CEO asking me to purchase gift cards. It looks very convincing with our company logo.
The barcode scanner at checkout lane 2 is not reading codes properly. It beeps but doesn't register any items in the POS system.
VPN connection is extremely slow today. Remote desktop sessions are lagging badly. This started happening after the network maintenance window.
I need access to the CRM system for our new sales team member who is covering the Southeast Asia region.
The inventory management software shows incorrect stock counts. After the last sync, 47 items show negative quantities.
We're getting DNS resolution errors for our internal systems. nslookup works for external sites but fails for internal hostnames.
My mailbox is full and I can't send or receive emails. The quota seems too low for our daily operations volume.
The network printer in the accounting department is showing offline status. We've checked the cables and they seem fine.
Excel is running very slow and frequently becomes unresponsive when working with our quarterly sales report which has about 50,000 rows.
Someone from the night shift noticed unusual login activity on the POS admin account. Multiple failed login attempts from an unknown IP address.
The power button on desktop PC-045 in the receiving bay doesn't respond. The machine was working fine yesterday when the evening shift ended.
We need to set up email forwarding for the customer.service@redwolf.com account to our new CRM ticketing system.
Internet speed in the main office has degraded significantly. Speed test shows 5Mbps down when we should be getting 200Mbps.
Please install Adobe Acrobat Reader on all warehouse workstations. The current version is outdated and some PDF invoices won't open.
I accidentally deleted an important email folder in Outlook. Is there any way to recover it? It contained customer order confirmations from last month.
The UPS connected to server rack B2 is beeping intermittently and shows a battery fault warning. We need to check if the battery needs replacement.
Remote access to the security camera system is not working. We can view feeds locally but the mobile app shows connection refused.
We suspect a data breach in the customer database. Several customers reported receiving spam emails using information only we should have.
The distribution list for the operations team keeps rejecting emails. Some team members were recently added but can't receive list emails.
Our warehouse management system crashed after the latest update. Now it shows a blank white screen when we try to log in.
The WiFi in the break room keeps dropping every 15 minutes. Staff are unable to use their personal devices during breaks.
Please create a new user account for our summer intern. They need basic computer access, email, and view-only inventory system permissions.
The color printer in the marketing department is producing streaky output. Colors are misaligned and there are horizontal lines across prints.
My keyboard is registering double keystrokes. When I type one letter, two appear. This started happening this morning.
The DHCP server seems to be running out of addresses. Several new devices are getting APIPA addresses in the 169.254.x.x range.
We need to upgrade the Microsoft Office license from Standard to Professional for the finance team. They need Access and Publisher.
The VPN disconnects every time the computer goes to sleep. I have to restart the AnyConnect client and re-authenticate each time.
Security scan found two vulnerabilities on our web server: an outdated SSL certificate and an unpatched Apache version.
Please change my password. I got a notification that my current password was found in a data breach on a third-party service.
The monitor at the front desk shows a green tint on the left half of the screen. Resetting display settings didn't help.
We need the printer driver installed for the new HP LaserJet in the shipping department. None of the shipping computers can print to it yet.
The CRM system is not syncing contacts from the email server. New customer entries from last week are missing from the CRM database.
Add me to the warehouse-ops distribution list. I recently transferred from the retail team and need to stay informed on warehouse operations.
The network switch in closet 2B is showing a red fault light. We're getting reports of connectivity issues from that section of the building.
My laptop battery drains from 100% to 0% in about 45 minutes. The laptop is only 6 months old and this started a week ago.
SharePoint is extremely slow when uploading files larger than 10MB. Uploads time out consistently for our product catalog images.
I'm seeing a blue screen error with code CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED when I boot my desktop. This started after the latest Windows update.
We need to set up a shared mailbox for the returns department. It should be accessible by 5 team members with full read-write permissions.
The system clock on all our POS terminals is showing the wrong time after the daylight saving change. Transactions are being recorded with incorrect timestamps.
Can someone explain the process for ordering new office supplies? I'm not sure which portal to use or who needs to approve the request.
